verdict.rationale: Zamzar is a file-conversion web service and API, not an AI agent or assistant host. Plugging in MCP servers so the product can call their tools is an MCP-client role, which is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Zamzar acting as an agent or tool-consuming client.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
